all: build_feint_flow dc_syn fm_r2g sta-pa

build_feint_flow: $(SCRIPT_DIR) $(WORK_DIR)
	@echo ">> Flow environment ready."

$(SCRIPT_DIR):
	@echo ">> Getting FEINT flow scripts from $(SCRIPT_REPO)..."
	cp -r $(SCRIPT_REPO)/scripts $(ROOT_DIR)
	cp -r $(SCRIPT_REPO)/setup   $(ROOT_DIR)


$(WORK_DIR):
	@mkdir -p $(WORK_DIR)/logs $(WORK_DIR)/reports $(WORK_DIR)/results $(ROOT_DIR)/data


dc_syn: $(SYN_DONE)

$(SYN_DONE): $(RTL_FILELIST) $(SDC_FILE) $(SCRIPT_DIR)/dc.tcl | $(WORK_DIR)
	@echo ">> Submitting DC synthesis..."
	$(call RUN, $(DESIGN)_syn, \
		module purge && \
		module load $(MODULE_SYN) && \
		cd $(WORK_DIR) && \
		dcnxt_shell -f $(SCRIPT_DIR)/dc.tcl \
			-x 'set DESIGN $(DESIGN); set RTL_FILELIST $(RTL_FILELIST); set SDC $(SDC_FILE); set ROOT_DIR $(ROOT_DIR)' \
			| tee logs/dc.log && \
		touch $(SYN_DONE) \
	)


dg_syn: 
	@echo ">> Submitting DC topographical synthesis..."
	$(call RUN, $(DESIGN)_syn, \
		module purge && \
		module load $(MODULE_SYN) && \
		cd $(WORK_DIR) && \
		dcnxt_shell -topo -f $(SCRIPT_DIR)/dc.tcl \
			-x 'set DESIGN $(DESIGN); set RTL_FILELIST $(RTL_FILELIST); set SDC $(SDC_FILE); set ROOT_DIR $(ROOT_DIR)' \
			| tee logs/dc.log && \
	)



fm_r2g fm_g2g: $(FM_DONE)

$(FM_DONE): $(SYN_DONE) $(SCRIPT_DIR)/fm.tcl
	@echo ">> Submitting Formality (mode: $(FM_MODE))..."
	$(call RUN, $(DESIGN)_fm_$(FM_MODE), \
		module purge && \
		module load $(MODULE_FM) && \
		cd $(WORK_DIR) && \
		fm_shell -f $(SCRIPT_DIR)/fm.tcl \
			-x 'set DESIGN $(DESIGN); set RTL_FILELIST $(RTL_FILELIST); set ROOT_DIR $(ROOT_DIR); set FM_MODE $(FM_MODE); set FM_REF_NETLIST $(FM_REF_NETLIST); set FM_IMPL_NETLIST $(FM_IMPL_NETLIST)' \
			| tee logs/fm_$(FM_MODE).log && \
		touch $(FM_DONE) \
	)


sta-pa: $(SYN_DONE) $(SCRIPT_DIR)/pt.tcl
	@echo ">> Submitting PTPX (corner: $(PT_CORNER))..."
	$(call RUN, $(DESIGN)_pa_$(PT_CORNER), \
		module purge && \
		module load $(MODULE_PA) && \
		module load $(MODULE_LC) && \
		cd $(WORK_DIR) && \
		pt_shell -f $(SCRIPT_DIR)/pt.tcl \
			-x 'set DESIGN $(DESIGN); set ROOT_DIR $(ROOT_DIR); set PT_CORNER $(PT_CORNER)' \
			| tee logs/pa_$(PT_CORNER).log && \
	)

pa_sweep:
	@if ! command -v xterm >/dev/null 2>&1; then \
		echo "ERROR: xterm not found. Run manually: make pa PT_CORNER=<corner>"; \
		exit 1; \
	fi
	@if [ -z "$$DISPLAY" ]; then \
		echo "ERROR: DISPLAY not set. Enable X11 forwarding or run manually."; \
		exit 1; \
	fi
	@for corner in $(PT_CORNERS); do \
		echo ">> Launching PA in xterm (corner: $$corner)..."; \
		xterm -hold -T "PA $(DESIGN) $$corner" \
			-e "$(MAKE) sta-pa PT_CORNER=$$corner" & \
		sleep 1; \
	done
	@echo ">> All PA jobs launched in xterm windows."

clean:
	rm -rf $(WORK_DIR)/results $(WORK_DIR)/reports $(WORK_DIR)/logs

#!/bin/csh -f
#===============================================================================
# file     : run_sta.csh
# purpose  : PrimeTime STA flow top-level run script (executed inside run/)
# usage    : run_sta.csh [-corner <corner>] [-mode <mode>] [-corners "c1 c2 ..."]
#                        [-modes "m1 m2 ..."] [-design <top>] [-clean] [-help]
#
# description:
#   - configures the environment and selects the PrimeTime tool (module load)
#   - creates the output directory hierarchy (log/ rpt/ sdc/ session/)
#   - launches pt_shell with scr/sta_main.tcl, passing design/corner/mode so the
#     flow can adapt to different PVT corners (tt/ss/ff) and functional/test modes
#===============================================================================

#--- resolve the absolute location of this script and the project root ----------
set SCRIPT  = $0
if ( "$SCRIPT" == "$SCRIPT:t" ) then
    set SCRIPT  = "$cwd/$SCRIPT"
endif
set RUN_DIR   = "$SCRIPT:h"
set ROOT_DIR  = "$RUN_DIR:h"
set SCR_DIR   = "$ROOT_DIR/scr"

#--- defaults --------------------------------------------------------------------
set DESIGN    = "design"
set CORNER    = "tt0p8v25c"
set MODE      = "func"
set CORNERS   = ""          # optional multi-corner list; empty => single corner
set MODES     = ""          # optional multi-mode list;   empty => single mode
set CLEAN     = 0
set HELP      = 0

#--- tool selection (PrimeTime) --------------------------------------------------
#   Prompt tool root : /apps/synopsys/primetime
#   A module must be loaded on this farm for the license to be picked up.
set PT_MODULE  = "pt/2022.12-SP5_os7"
set PT_SHELL   = "pt_shell"

#--- parse command line options --------------------------------------------------
set i = 1
while ( $i <= $#argv )
    switch ( "$argv[$i]" )
        case "-corner":
            @ i++
            set CORNER = "$argv[$i]"
            breaksw
        case "-mode":
            @ i++
            set MODE = "$argv[$i]"
            breaksw
        case "-corners":
            @ i++
            set CORNERS = "$argv[$i]"
            breaksw
        case "-modes":
            @ i++
            set MODES = "$argv[$i]"
            breaksw
        case "-design":
            @ i++
            set DESIGN = "$argv[$i]"
            breaksw
        case "-clean":
            set CLEAN = 1
            breaksw
        case "-help":
        case "-h":
            set HELP = 1
            breaksw
        default:
            echo "ERROR: unknown option '$argv[$i]'"
            exit 1
    endsw

#!/bin/csh -f
#===============================================================================
# FILE    : run_sta.csh
# PURPOSE : PrimeTime STA flow top-level run script (executed inside run/)
#
# This cshell wrapper:
#   * configures the runtime environment and selects the PrimeTime tool
#     (module load is required on this farm so that the license is picked up)
#   * creates the output directory hierarchy (log/ rpt/ sdc/ session/)
#   * launches pt_shell with scr/sta_main.tcl, passing design/corner/mode so the
#     flow can adapt to different PVT corners (tt/ss/ff) and functional/test modes
#
# USAGE:
#   run_sta.csh [-corner <corner>]  [-mode <mode>]
#               [-corners "c1 c2 ..."] [-modes "m1 m2 ..."]
#               [-design <top>] [-clean] [-help]
#
#   corner examples : tt0p8v25c  ss0p72vm40c  ff0p88v125c
#   mode   examples : func  test  hold
#
# Reference flow (modelled after):
#   /apps/imctf/cad/script/digital_flow/feint  (synopsys pt reference flow)
#===============================================================================

#--- resolve absolute location of this script, then the project root -----------
set ARGV0   = "$0"
if ( "$ARGV0" == "$ARGV0:t" ) then
    set ARGV0 = "$cwd/$ARGV0"
endif
cd `dirname "$ARGV0"`
set RUN_DIR  = `pwd`
cd ..
set ROOT_DIR = `pwd`
cd $RUN_DIR
set SCR_DIR  = "$ROOT_DIR/scr"

#--- defaults ------------------------------------------------------------------
set DESIGN   = "design"
set CORNER   = "tt0p8v25c"
set MODE     = "func"
set CORNERS  = ""          ;# optional multi-corner list; empty => single -corner
set MODES    = ""          ;# optional multi-mode list;   empty => single -mode
set CLEAN    = 0
set HELP     = 0

#--- tool selection (PrimeTime) ------------------------------------------------
# Prompt tool root : /apps/synopsys/primetime
# A module must be loaded on this farm so the license is correctly obtained.
set PT_MODULE = "pt/2022.12-SP5_os7"
set PT_SHELL  = "pt_shell"

#--- command line parsing ------------------------------------------------------
set i = 1
while ( $i <= $#argv )
    switch ( "$argv[$i]" )
        case "-corner":
            @ i++
            set CORNER = "$argv[$i]"
            breaksw
        case "-mode":
            @ i++
            set MODE = "$argv[$i]"
            breaksw
        case "-corners":
            @ i++
            set CORNERS = "$argv[$i]"
            breaksw
        case "-modes":
            @ i++
            set MODES = "$argv[$i]"
            breaksw
        case "-design":
            @ i++
            set DESIGN = "$argv[$i]"
            breaksw
        case "-clean":
            set CLEAN = 1
            breaksw
        case "-h":
        case "-help":
            set HELP = 1
            breaksw
        default:
            echo "ERROR: unknown option '$argv[$i]'"
            exit 1
    endsw
    @ i++
end

if ( $HELP == 1 ) then
    echo "usage: $ARGV0:t [-corner <corner>] [-mode <mode>] [-corners \"c1 c2\"] [-modes \"m1 m2\"] [-design <top>] [-clean]"
    echo "  corners : tt0p8v25c ss0p72vm40c ff0p88v125c"
    echo "  modes   : func test hold"
    exit 0
endif

#--- environment configuration & output directories ---------------------------
set LOG_DIR = "$ROOT_DIR/log"
set RPT_DIR = "$ROOT_DIR/rpt"
set SDC_DIR = "$ROOT_DIR/sdc"
set SES_DIR = "$ROOT_DIR/session"

if ( $CLEAN == 1 ) then
    echo "RM-Info: cleaning output dirs"
    rm -rf $LOG_DIR $RPT_DIR $SDC_DIR $SES_DIR
endif
mkdir -p $LOG_DIR $RPT_DIR $SDC_DIR $SES_DIR

#--- load the PrimeTime module (tool selection + license setup) ----------------
if ( "$PT_MODULE" != "" ) then
    which module >& /dev/null
    if ( $status == 0 ) then
        echo "RM-Info: module load $PT_MODULE"
        module load $PT_MODULE
    else
        echo "RM-Warning: 'module' not found; assuming $PT_SHELL is on PATH"
    endif
endif

#--- derive the corner/mode run lists ------------------------------------------
if ( "$CORNERS" == "" ) set CORNERS = "$CORNER"
if ( "$MODES"   == "" ) set MODES   = "$MODE"

#--- launch PrimeTime ----------------------------------------------------------
cd $RUN_DIR
set RUNCORNER = ""
foreach RUNCORNER ( $CORNERS )
    set RUNMODE = ""
    foreach RUNMODE ( $MODES )
        set TAG = "${DESIGN}_${RUNCORNER}_${RUNMODE}"
        echo "==================================================================="
        echo " RM-Info: STA run -> design=$DESIGN corner=$RUNCORNER mode=$RUNMODE"
        echo "==================================================================="

        set PT_X = "set ROOT_DIR $ROOT_DIR; set RUN_DIR $RUN_DIR; set SCR_DIR $SCR_DIR; set LOG_DIR $LOG_DIR; set RPT_DIR $RPT_DIR; set SDC_DIR $SDC_DIR; set SES_DIR $SES_DIR; set DESIGN_NAME $DESIGN; set PT_CORNER $RUNCORNER; set PT_MODE $RUNMODE"

        $PT_SHELL -f $SCR_DIR/sta_main.tcl -x "$PT_X" |& tee $LOG_DIR/sta_${TAG}.log
        if ( $status != 0 ) then
            echo "ERROR: PrimeTime returned non-zero for $TAG"
            exit 1
        endif
    end
end

echo "RM-Info: STA flow finished."
echo "  logs    -> $LOG_DIR"
echo "  reports -> $RPT_DIR"
echo "  sdc     -> $SDC_DIR"
echo "  session -> $SES_DIR"
exit 0

set_timing_derate -late  $OCV_DERATE_LATE

# Clock uncertainty for setup/hold (default margin).

if {![info exists CLK_UNCERTAINTY_HOLD]}  { set CLK_UNCERTAINTY_HOLD  0.030 }

#!/bin/csh -f
#===============================================================================
# FILE    : run_sta.csh
# PURPOSE : PrimeTime STA flow top-level run script (executed inside run/)
#
# This cshell wrapper:
#   * configures the runtime environment and selects the PrimeTime tool
#     (module load is required on this farm so that the license is picked up)
#   * creates the output directory hierarchy (log/ rpt/ sdc/ session/)
#   * launches pt_shell with scr/sta_main.tcl, passing design/corner/mode so the
#     flow can adapt to different PVT corners (tt/ss/ff) and functional/test modes
#
# USAGE:
#   run_sta.csh [-corner <corner>]  [-mode <mode>]
#               [-corners "c1 c2 ..."] [-modes "m1 m2 ..."]
#               [-design <top>] [-clean] [-help]
#
#   corner examples : tt0p8v25c  ss0p72vm40c  ff0p88v125c
#   mode   examples : func  test  hold
#
# Reference flow (modelled after):
#   /apps/imctf/cad/script/digital_flow/feint  (synopsys pt reference flow)
#===============================================================================

#--- resolve absolute location of this script, then the project root -----------
set ARGV0   = "$0"
if ( "$ARGV0" == "$ARGV0:t" ) then
    set ARGV0 = "$cwd/$ARGV0"
endif
cd `dirname "$ARGV0"`
set RUN_DIR  = `pwd`
cd ..
set ROOT_DIR = `pwd`
cd $RUN_DIR
set SCR_DIR  = "$ROOT_DIR/scr"

#--- defaults ------------------------------------------------------------------
set DESIGN   = "design"
set CORNER   = "tt0p8v25c"
set MODE     = "func"
set CORNERS  = ""          ;# optional multi-corner list; empty => single -corner
set MODES    = ""          ;# optional multi-mode list;   empty => single -mode
set CLEAN    = 0
set HELP     = 0

#--- tool selection (PrimeTime) ------------------------------------------------
# Prompt tool root : /apps/synopsys/primetime
# A module must be loaded on this farm so the license is correctly obtained.
set PT_MODULE = "pt/2022.12-SP5_os7"
set PT_SHELL  = "pt_shell"

#--- command line parsing ------------------------------------------------------
set i = 1
while ( $i <= $#argv )
    switch ( "$argv[$i]" )
        case "-corner":
            @ i++
            set CORNER = "$argv[$i]"
            breaksw
        case "-mode":
            @ i++
            set MODE = "$argv[$i]"
            breaksw
        case "-corners":
            @ i++
            set CORNERS = "$argv[$i]"
            breaksw
        case "-modes":
            @ i++
            set MODES = "$argv[$i]"
            breaksw
        case "-design":
            @ i++
            set DESIGN = "$argv[$i]"
            breaksw
        case "-clean":
            set CLEAN = 1
            breaksw
        case "-h":
        case "-help":
            set HELP = 1
            breaksw
        default:
            echo "ERROR: unknown option '$argv[$i]'"
            exit 1
    endsw
    @ i++
end

if ( $HELP == 1 ) then
    echo "usage: $ARGV0:t [-corner <corner>] [-mode <mode>] [-corners \"c1 c2\"] [-modes \"m1 m2\"] [-design <top>] [-clean]"
    echo "  corners : tt0p8v25c ss0p72vm40c ff0p88v125c"
    echo "  modes   : func test hold"
    exit 0
endif

#--- environment configuration & output directories ---------------------------
set LOG_DIR = "$ROOT_DIR/log"
set RPT_DIR = "$ROOT_DIR/rpt"
set SDC_DIR = "$ROOT_DIR/sdc"
set SES_DIR = "$ROOT_DIR/session"

if ( $CLEAN == 1 ) then
    echo "RM-Info: cleaning output dirs"
    rm -rf $LOG_DIR $RPT_DIR $SDC_DIR $SES_DIR
endif
mkdir -p $LOG_DIR $RPT_DIR $SDC_DIR $SES_DIR

#--- load the PrimeTime module (tool selection + license setup) ----------------
if ( "$PT_MODULE" != "" ) then
    which module >& /dev/null
    if ( $status == 0 ) then
        echo "RM-Info: module load $PT_MODULE"
        module load $PT_MODULE
    else
        echo "RM-Warning: 'module' not found; assuming $PT_SHELL is on PATH"
    endif
endif

#--- derive the corner/mode run lists ------------------------------------------
if ( "$CORNERS" == "" ) set CORNERS = "$CORNER"
if ( "$MODES"   == "" ) set MODES   = "$MODE"

#--- launch PrimeTime ----------------------------------------------------------
cd $RUN_DIR
set RUNCORNER = ""
foreach RUNCORNER ( $CORNERS )
    set RUNMODE = ""
    foreach RUNMODE ( $MODES )
        set TAG = "${DESIGN}_${RUNCORNER}_${RUNMODE}"
        echo "==================================================================="
        echo " RM-Info: STA run -> design=$DESIGN corner=$RUNCORNER mode=$RUNMODE"
        echo "==================================================================="

        set PT_X = "set ROOT_DIR $ROOT_DIR; set RUN_DIR $RUN_DIR; set SCR_DIR $SCR_DIR; set LOG_DIR $LOG_DIR; set RPT_DIR $RPT_DIR; set SDC_DIR $SDC_DIR; set SES_DIR $SES_DIR; set DESIGN_NAME $DESIGN; set PT_CORNER $RUNCORNER; set PT_MODE $RUNMODE"

        $PT_SHELL -f $SCR_DIR/sta_main.tcl -x "$PT_X" |& tee $LOG_DIR/sta_${TAG}.log
        if ( $status != 0 ) then
            echo "ERROR: PrimeTime returned non-zero for $TAG"
            exit 1
        endif
    end
end

echo "RM-Info: STA flow finished."
echo "  logs    -> $LOG_DIR"
echo "  reports -> $RPT_DIR"
echo "  sdc     -> $SDC_DIR"
echo "  session -> $SES_DIR"
exit 0

#===============================================================================
# FILE    : 1_setup.tcl
# PURPOSE : Environment configuration & tool selection (step 1 of the STA flow).
#   * resolve the project directory hierarchy (run/ scr/ log/ rpt/ sdc/ session/ data/)
#   * select the PrimeTime tool and corner-aware analysis libraries
#   * enable the key STA features (CCS waveform propagation, POCV)
#   All variables are overridable via the -x assignments emitted by run_sta.csh.
#===============================================================================
puts "RM-Info: [info script] : environment configuration & tool selection"

#---- directories -------------------------------------------------------------
if {![info exists ROOT_DIR]} { set ROOT_DIR  [file normalize [file dirname [pwd]]] }
set RUN_DIR  [file join $ROOT_DIR run]
set SCR_DIR  [file join $ROOT_DIR scr]
set LOG_DIR  [file join $ROOT_DIR log]
set RPT_DIR  [file join $ROOT_DIR rpt]
set SDC_DIR  [file join $ROOT_DIR sdc]
set SES_DIR  [file join $ROOT_DIR session]
set DATA_DIR [file join $ROOT_DIR data]

foreach d [list $LOG_DIR $RPT_DIR $SDC_DIR $SES_DIR] {
    file mkdir $d
}

#---- design / corner / mode ----------------------------------------------------
if {![info exists DESIGN_NAME]} { set DESIGN_NAME "design" }
if {![info exists PT_CORNER]}   { set PT_CORNER   "tt0p8v25c" }
if {![info exists PT_MODE]}     { set PT_MODE     "func" }

puts "RM-Info: DESIGN_NAME = $DESIGN_NAME"
puts "RM-Info: PT_CORNER   = $PT_CORNER"
puts "RM-Info: PT_MODE     = $PT_MODE"

#---- tool selection (PrimeTime) -------------------------------------------------
# PrimeTime lives under /apps/synopsys/primetime and is exposed through the
# environment module 'pt/...' loaded by run/run_sta.csh. This variable is kept
# available so the shell binary can be located explicitly if it is not on PATH.
if {![info exists PT_TOOL_DIR]} { set PT_TOOL_DIR "/apps/synopsys/primetime" }
puts "RM-Info: PT_TOOL_DIR = $PT_TOOL_DIR"

#---- corner-aware library configuration -----------------------------------------
# The demo input netlist / libraries / SDC are expected under DATA_DIR. Corner
# specific Liberty databases live in data/lib/<corner>/.
set LIB_BASE [file join $DATA_DIR "lib" $PT_CORNER]

if {![info exists ADDITIONAL_SEARCH_PATH]} { set ADDITIONAL_SEARCH_PATH "" }
set search_path [concat . $DATA_DIR $LIB_BASE $ADDITIONAL_SEARCH_PATH]

if {![info exists ANALYSIS_LIBRARY_FILES]} {
    set ANALYSIS_LIBRARY_FILES [concat \
        [glob -nocomplain [file join $LIB_BASE "*.db"]] \
        [glob -nocomplain [file join $LIB_BASE "*.lib"]] ]
}
if {![info exists ADDITIONAL_LINK_LIB_FILES]} {
    set ADDITIONAL_LINK_LIB_FILES $ANALYSIS_LIBRARY_FILES
}

# target_library : cells used for mapping/delay calc of the cell library
# link_library   : everything needed to resolve the design references
set target_library $ANALYSIS_LIBRARY_FILES
set link_path      [concat {*} $target_library $ADDITIONAL_LINK_LIB_FILES]

puts "RM-Info: target_library = $target_library"
puts "RM-Info: link_path      = $link_path"

#---- enable key features ----------------------------------------------------------
set sh_continue_on_error                true
set delay_calc_waveform_analysis_mode   full_design   ;# CCS-based waveform propagation
set timing_pocvm_enable_analysis        true          ;# POCV (LVF) statistical timing
set si_enable_analysis                  true          ;# crosstalk analysis

#---- common report tag -------------------------------------------------------------
set REPORT_TAG "${DESIGN_NAME}_${PT_CORNER}_${PT_MODE}"
set REPORT_PREFIX [file join $RPT_DIR $REPORT_TAG]

puts "RM-Info: [info script] completed"

#===============================================================================
# FILE    : 5_link_design.tcl
# PURPOSE : Link the gate-level design against the read libraries and validate it.
#===============================================================================
puts "RM-Info: [info script] : linking design"

if {![info exists DESIGN_NAME]} { set DESIGN_NAME "design" }

# Enable library auto-detect so the design name can be resolved from the netlist
# if DESIGN_NAME is left generic, then link explicitly.
set link_disable_auto_detect true
link_design $DESIGN_NAME
current_design $DESIGN_NAME

# Basic design sanity checks. Any unresolved reference is reported by
# report_reference (typically caused by a missing submodule library, see
# 3_read_library.tcl).
check_design
report_reference > [file join $RPT_DIR "${REPORT_TAG}.reference.rpt"]

puts "RM-Info: [info script] completed"

#===============================================================================
# FILE    : 6_timing_config.tcl
# PURPOSE : Timing analysis configuration: operating conditions, derating,
#           clock margins, path groups and analysis options for the corner/mode.
#===============================================================================
puts "RM-Info: [info script] : timing analysis configuration"

# Operating condition: derive the PVT/RC corner operating condition from the
# target library (single analysis). Switch to multi-corner via set_operating_conditions
# when MCMM runs are launched through the -corners sweep in run_sta.csh.
if {[info exists OPERATING_CONDITION]} {
    set_operating_conditions $OPERATING_CONDITION
} else {
    set_operating_conditions -analysis_type on_chip_variation
}

# On-chip variation derates (placeholder values; adjust per signoff methodology).
if {![info exists OCV_DERATE_EARLY]} { set OCV_DERATE_EARLY 0.90 }
if {![info exists OCV_DERATE_LATE]}  { set OCV_DERATE_LATE  1.10 }

set_timing_derate -early $OCV_DERATE_EARLY
set_timing_derate -late  $OCV_DERATE_LATE

# Clock uncertainty for setup/hold (default margin).
if {![info exists CLK_UNCERTAINTY_SETUP]} { set CLK_UNCERTAINTY_SETUP 0.050 }
if {![info exists CLK_UNCERTAINTY_HOLD]}  { set CLK_UNCERTAINTY_HOLD  0.030 }
set_clock_uncertainty -setup $CLK_UNCERTAINTY_SETUP [all_clocks]
set_clock_uncertainty -hold  $CLK_UNCERTAINTY_HOLD  [all_clocks]

# Path groups: one group per clock domain.
if {[llength [all_clocks]] > 0} {
    group_path -name REG2REG -from [all_registers -clock_pins] -to [all_registers -data_pins]
    group_path -name IN2REG  -from [all_inputs]                -to [all_registers -data_pins]
    group_path -name REG2OUT -from [all_registers -clock_pins] -to [all_outputs]
    group_path -name IN2OUT  -from [all_inputs]                -to [all_outputs]
}

# Report analysis mode and margins.
puts "RM-Info: OCV early=[expr {100.0*$OCV_DERATE_EARLY}]% late=[expr {100.0*$OCV_DERATE_LATE}]%"
puts "RM-Info: clock uncertainty setup=$CLK_UNCERTAINTY_SETUP hold=$CLK_UNCERTAINTY_HOLD"

puts "RM-Info: [info script] completed"

#===============================================================================
# FILE    : 7_update_timing.tcl
# PURPOSE : Update (propagate) timing for the configured corner/mode and run
#           quick timing sanity / constraint checks.
#===============================================================================
puts "RM-Info: [info script] : updating timing"

update_timing -full

# Quick sanity checks on the timing environment.
check_timing -verbose

# Report all timing violations (one line per path) into the report directory.
report_constraint -all_violators \
    > [file join $RPT_DIR "${REPORT_TAG}.constraint.rpt"]

# Also dump the annotated timing to the command log for traceability.
echo "RM-Info: timing updated for ${DESIGN_NAME} (${PT_CORNER}/${PT_MODE})"

puts "RM-Info: [info script] completed"

#===============================================================================
# FILE    : 8_report_timing.tcl
# PURPOSE : Timing reports (setup/hold) for the current corner/mode.
#===============================================================================
puts "RM-Info: [info script] : reporting timing"

set timing_rpt_file [file join $RPT_DIR "${REPORT_TAG}.timing.rpt"]
set timing_paths_txt [file join $RPT_DIR "${REPORT_TAG}.paths.rpt"]

# Setup (max delay) report: top N violating / near-violating paths.
report_timing \
    -delay_type  max \
    -max_paths   200 \
    -nworst      5 \
    -path_type   full_clock_expanded \
    -slack_lesser_than 0.0 \
    > $timing_rpt_file

# Hold (min delay) report: top N violating / near-violating paths.
report_timing \
    -delay_type  min \
    -max_paths   200 \
    -nworst      5 \
    -path_type   full_clock_expanded \
    -slack_lesser_than 0.0 \
    >> $timing_rpt_file

# One-line summary of the most critical endpoints.
report_timing \
    -delay_type max \
    -max_paths  20 \
    -path_type  end \
    > $timing_paths_txt

puts "RM-Info: timing report written to $timing_rpt_file"
puts "RM-Info: [info script] completed"

#===============================================================================
# FILE    : 9_write_output.tcl
# PURPOSE : Emit the generated output files:
#             * sdc/     -> a generated .sdc snapshot (write_sdc)
#             * session/ -> an interactive pt_shell session snapshot (save_session)
#             * rpt/     -> optional SDF (write_sdf) for downstream signoff
#===============================================================================
puts "RM-Info: [info script] : writing outputs"

# Generated SDC: captures all constraints currently effective on the design
# (this is what the sdc/ directory is meant to hold).
set gen_sdc [file join $SDC_DIR "${REPORT_TAG}.sdc"]
write_sdc -version 2.1 $gen_sdc
puts "RM-Info: generated SDC -> $gen_sdc"

# Save an interactive session so the flow can be resumed interactively in
# pt_shell (this is what the session/ directory is meant to hold).
set session_name [file join $SES_DIR $REPORT_TAG]
save_session $session_name
puts "RM-Info: saved session -> $session_name"

# Optional timing (SDF) back-annotation output for downstream tools.
if {[info exists WRITE_SDF] && $WRITE_SDF} {
    set gen_sdf [file join $RPT_DIR "${REPORT_TAG}.sdf"]
    write_sdf -version 3.0 $gen_sdf
    puts "RM-Info: generated SDF -> $gen_sdf"
}

puts "RM-Info: [info script] completed"

#===============================================================================
# FILE    : 10_rpt.tcl
# PURPOSE : Final STA reports: quality-of-results, timing, constraints, area and
#           power summary, all written into the rpt/ directory.
#===============================================================================
puts "RM-Info: [info script] : final reports"

set qor_rpt_file     [file join $RPT_DIR "${REPORT_TAG}.qor.rpt"]
set timing_rpt_file  [file join $RPT_DIR "${REPORT_TAG}.timing.rpt"]
set viol_rpt_file    [file join $RPT_DIR "${REPORT_TAG}.violators.rpt"]
set area_rpt_file    [file join $RPT_DIR "${REPORT_TAG}.area.rpt"]
set power_rpt_file   [file join $RPT_DIR "${REPORT_TAG}.power.rpt"]

# Quality-of-results summary (WNS/TNS per clock group).
report_qor -summary > $qor_rpt_file

# Worst violating paths, short summary.
report_timing -delay_type max -max_paths 50 -path_type end \
    > $viol_rpt_file

# Full timing snapshot appended (mirrors step 8).
report_timing -delay_type max -max_paths 200 -nworst 5 \
    -path_type full_clock_expanded \
    > $timing_rpt_file

# Area report.
report_area -hierarchy > $area_rpt_file

# Power report (average power).
if {[info exists PT_POWER_ANALYSIS]} {
    report_power -hierarchy > $power_rpt_file
} else {
    # Power is optional; still attempt it but do not fail the flow.
    if {[catch {report_power -hierarchy} power_rc]} {
        puts "RM-Warning: report_power skipped: $power_rc"
    } else {
        report_power -hierarchy > $power_rpt_file
    }
}

puts "RM-Info: reports written under $RPT_DIR"
puts "RM-Info: [info script] completed"
